Infinigen AssetFactory list  — ROLE-tagged for factory selection
source: PC_Blen/Infinigen/infinigen/infinigen/assets
ROLES verified from Infinigen source (NOT guessed):
  - ENTRY: the object is in infinigen's own standalone-asset test lists
    (tests/assets/list_{nature,indoor}_meshes.txt) or is a whole placeable object
    not instantiated as a sub-part of another factory.
  - PART : a *Base* skeleton, a creatures/parts/* body part, a cached/util engine,
    OR an ELEMENT (single leaf / blossom / berry / seed / needle / single fruit)
    that a plant/tree [ENTRY] instances. Elements are generatable alone but the
    director should NOT pick them as a whole object.
======================================================================
HOW TO SELECT (director): map a requested object to exactly ONE [ENTRY]. NEVER
pick a [PART]; reach a part only by going deeper FROM its [ENTRY] template.
e.g. "cherry blossom tree" -> TreeFactory [ENTRY] (which uses TreeFlowerFactory
[PART] for blossoms + a leaf/fruit [PART]) — NOT TreeFlowerFactory (one flower).
======================================================================
